features.note: Blockout-vs-final strip and all 33 views preserve the 60x45 grammar: red-band facade threshold with marquee and accessible path, 7 m center spine (corridor views + roof-off), 4+4 room masses labeled 1L-4S / 5L-8S in es-arch, and a separated rear service strip (REAR SERVICE label, technical view). Roof-off probative view reveals true interiors with no roof plates and no phantom ceiling planes; only the duct mains remain on the spine deck.

2/4/2 reads via labeled plates (1L,2M,3M,4S / 5L,6M,7M,8S) and width differences; east-end parapets step down toward the small rooms. Sala 3 interior shows tiered burgundy rows, center+side aisles, screen with abstract content, speaker proxies, step LEDs. Within-family plate steps are subtle from above; charcoal fascias carry most of the articulation.

Continuous exterior-to-corridor sequence: marquee + 4 generative posters + yellow accessible lane, glossy-tile lobby with cove lights, dominant concession counter with POS faces and menu boards, kitchen workline with hood-to-duct-to-ceiling contact (native crop confirms), then checkpoint lane into the numbered corridor. Checkpoint fit-out is the weak link: gate masses are featureless grey blocks; only the lane gap, floor markers and podium signal the function.

Engineering views expose TC300 fleet on green RS-485 trunks with drops, 4 UC cabinets (UC-B/C/D labels at gateway, UCA on trunk), one two-antenna UG67 with pulse rings, dashed-blue UC-to-UG67 links, and one solid-blue IP chain ROUTER/FIREWALL-INTERNET-NIAGARA-PC/TABLET/SMARTPHONE with no shortcut edge. Fault semantics corroborate counts: TC300 fault = 1 event, UC100-B = 4, internet = 14 thermostats with grey unreachable chain and red break node; hot states keep 'Niagara sigue recibiendo datos'.

Architecture state is clean opaque massing with the external schematic blocks and diagram board fully hidden (net-arch shows building only); engineering state shows translucent shell, zone tints, device markers, three media styles and the diagram board on the same geometry and camera. Selection (es/ug67) highlights one path with ring cursor; fault captures keep a single coherent building. All animation pairs differ by pixel diff (es 0.4%, ug67 14.8%, net 1.0%, poster/menu/lightsoff pairs all nonzero).

important_features.note: 1.8 m person at facade and corridor scales correctly against 2.1 m doors and the 2.5 m RTU cabinets; TC300 reads as a small wall device with display cue plus conduit drop, not inflated; UG67 antennas read at the gateway.

Bright marquee/lobby/menus grade into dim carpeted corridor and low-emission sala with blue step LEDs, yellow aisle lines and green exits; all four lights-off pairs clearly differ. Weakness: sala3 lights-off seat masses measure ~3/255 vs ~6/255 walls - silhouettes are borderline readable, carried mostly by step LEDs and faint aisle lines.

All visible RTUs (13 in neutral, 14 corroborated across facade/es/grazing) seat on dark curbs in contact with their roof plates - native crop confirms curb, condenser ring, intake hood; supply/return mains sit on the spine service band with strapped joints; kitchen hood contacts its duct and ceiling; cyan conduit drops serve corridor devices. Supply drops into zones are not visually verifiable from any capture, and the UC100-B cabinet does not read in the technical preset.
